question: Amongst six friends C, V, Z, N, X and B, each has a different height. Z is taller than only four other friends. N is taller than only one friend. X is taller than B but shorter than V. V is not the tallest. Who is the tallest among all the friends?
solution:
The following arrangement is as follows:

1) Z is taller than only four other friends.

** _ > Z > _ > _ > _> _**

2) N is taller than only one friend.
